blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) and the University of the Philippines (UP) Diliman have formalized a partnership aimed at strengthening the country’s use of population data as the Philippines faces major demographic changes. UNFPA Philippines Country Representative Neus Bernabeu and UP Diliman Chancellor Edgardo Carlo L. Vistan II signed the Implementing Partner Agreement on Sept. 15 at Quezon Hall, building on the two institutions’ decades-long collaboration, particularly with the UP Population Institute (UPPI). As part of the partnership, UPPI will work with key government agencies on population data, including efforts to improve how such information is collected, […]...
